source: Ticker skeleton: TOPIX 500 constituent list dated 2022-02 (via systemtrade-kabu.com, sourced from JPX end-of-month master data; no current 2026 TOPIX 500 machine-readable list was locatable via web search at fetch time -- JPX's live weighting file requires a paid Index Data Service subscription / client portal login) + 6 manually-verified large-cap supplemental tickers confirmed via yfinance to be >=JPY100bn and confirmed absent from the 2022 list (post-2022 IPOs/spin-offs not yet reflected in that vintage: Tokyo Metro 9023.T, Kioxia Holdings 285A.T, Rakuten Bank 5838.T, Kokusai Electric 6525.T, Socionext 6526.T, JX Advanced Metals 5016.T). Fundamentals: yfinance get_info() per ticker, python3 / yfinance 1.2.0, fetched 2026-08-14 in batches of 25 with 3-5s inter-batch sleep and one 30s-delayed retry per failed ticker per the repo's yfinance rate-limit protocol.

coverage.unresolved_note: These tickers returned a reproducible near-empty yfinance payload (no name, no marketCap, no sector) on both the original fetch and an independent re-fetch pass -- confirmed NOT a transient 429/rate-limit artifact. Most likely explanation: the 2022-vintage TOPIX 500 skeleton contains tickers that have since delisted, gone private, merged, or had their code reassigned (e.g. 6502.T was Toshiba, which was taken private via TOB in Dec 2023). These names are EXCLUDED from `stocks` and from all coverage/sector/P-B stats below because their current market cap could not be confirmed either way -- they are neither confirmed >=JPY100bn nor confirmed below it.
